item.title: Add support for adding custom models via LiteLLM
item.body:
**Title**: Add support for integrating custom models via LiteLLM in Trae

**Description**:
We would like to enhance Trae by adding support for integrating custom models using [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm), similar to the existing support for OpenRouter. This will allow developers to route requests through a variety of model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, etc.) using a unified LiteLLM endpoint.

**Use Case**:
This integration will enable teams to:

* Use a single API interface to switch between different LLM providers via LiteLLM

**Feature Requirements**:

* Ability to add and configure a LiteLLM endpoint through the Trae interface or configuration.
* Support for model selection
* Option to route requests through LiteLLM in the same way OpenRouter is currently supported.

**Reference**:
LiteLLM GitHub: [https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm)
